notes: Positions only: where in the program ROM the palette of each 16x16 tile (its number in the tile ROM) starts; tools/palette_census.py writes it.

'drawn': the palette the 16x16 tile (its number in the tile ROM) was shown with in the scenarios; 'nearby': one no scenario shows, given the palette of the 16x16 tile (its number in the tile ROM) before it; 'chosen': picked by hand where those are wrong (a frame caught during a flash, a neighbour's palette that is not its own), and used instead of them.
